final_rationale: The verdict changes because the Actor narrowed the position to one that matches the admissible record; no new admissible evidence was introduced. The evidence supports aggregate launch readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents, but it also supports an unresolved slice-specific weakness and an incomplete mitigation artifact. Under the policy text, that combination does not support unconditional certification or any claim that no material limitations remain. It does support a bounded position: certification is defensible only with explicit disclosure of the seller-enforcement limitation, or with approved risk acceptance not present in this record. That is enough for compliant_with_caveats, not full compliance. The caveat is not a minor drafting preference; it is the active compliance condition required by the evidence and policy.
